high_level_description: This image is a screenshot from an Instagram post by the account "mindset.therapy." The post features a dramatic scene of a rainbow arching over a body of water, likely the ocean, with a dark, cloudy sky in the background. The rainbow is vivid and prominent, with colors transitioning smoothly from red at the top to violet at the bottom. The text overlay on the image reads, "Your opinion is not my reality," which is positioned centrally below the rainbow. This text suggests a theme of personal autonomy and the importance of one's own perspective over external opinions or judgments.
